name: moodler
description: Browser-based editor for Moodle quiz questions: create, import, edit, reorder and export Moodle XML, GIFT and Aiken, with a live preview.

paragraphs: A frontend-only web app for creating and editing Moodle quiz questions. It runs entirely in the browser: nothing is uploaded, and your work is saved automatically in the browser (IndexedDB, so quizzes with many images fit).
Built with Svelte 5 and Vite, and deployed to GitHub Pages at
features: Multiple quizzes: keep as many quizzes as you like in the browser. Every quiz has a tab under the header showing its question count: click to switch (or Alt+1–9), double-click to rename, drag to reorder, and right-click…

Question types: multiple choice (single or multiple answers), true/false, short answer, numerical (with units), essay, matching, embedded answers (Cloze), select missing words, drag and drop into text, ordering, and…

Import: Moodle XML, GIFT (including missing-word), Aiken, Embedded answers (Cloze), and the editor's own JSON project format. Upload a file or paste text. The format is detected automatically. Pasting questions anywhere…

Export: Moodle XML (full fidelity, including embedded images, hints, tags and categories), GIFT, Aiken and JSON. Export the whole quiz or only the questions you tick. Before you download, the export dialog lists every…

Editing: a rich-text editor with image paste and drop, HTML source view and TeX insertion. You can edit per-answer grades and feedback, combined feedback, hints, tags, penalties, ID numbers and category overrides.
